title: VACANCY NOTICE Graduate Trainnees LSS X 2 (002)
text:
VACANCY NOTICE – GT’s OPERATIONS X 2
The Securities and Exchange Commission of Zimbabwe is inviting applications
from suitably qualified candidates for a structured graduate-traineeship
program in the Operations Department.
Core Competencies:
• Proficiency with Microsoft Packages and Databases.
• Good communication skills.
• Ability to work as part of a team.
• Excellent interpersonal skills.
• Data Analytics and Strong Quantitative skills.
Duties and Responsibilities:
• Assist in carrying out daily market surveillance activities on key market
infrastructures and reporting of all suspicious trades/transactions and
any other breaches.
• Participate in market supervision activities, including all inspection
programs aimed at securing compliance with regulatory requirements by
all Securities Market Intermediaries and Collective Investment Schemes.
• Draft stress tests and risk assessment reports to detect market risks and
recommend appropriate interventions.
• Measure licensees’ risk and internal control systems (including capital
adequacy) and effectively manage risk policies and strategies.
Requisite Qualifications & Experience:
• Recent graduate with a Commerce/Business Related Degree (Actuarial
Sciences, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Economics, Risk Management)
or any related field.
• Proficiency in risk and financial modelling using computer-based
packages.
Application letters with C.V.s to be e-mailed to recruitment@seczim.co.zw with the
position being applied for clearly stated in the email subject. These should reach us
NOT LATER THAN 13 JANUARY 2026. N/B Only shortlisted candidates will be responded
to.
